static OPJ_BOOL opj_j2k_get_sot_values(OPJ_BYTE *  p_header_data,
                                       OPJ_UINT32 p_header_size,
                                       OPJ_UINT32 * p_tile_no,
                                       OPJ_UINT32 * p_tot_len,
                                       OPJ_UINT32 * p_current_part,
                                       OPJ_UINT32 * p_num_parts,
                                       opj_event_mgr_t * p_manager)
{
    /* preconditions */
    assert(p_header_data != 00);
    assert(p_manager != 00);

    /* Size of the SOT marker */
    if (p_header_size < 10) {
        opj_event_msg(p_manager, EVT_ERROR, "Error reading SOT marker\n");
        return OPJ_FALSE;
    }

    /* 2 bytes: Tile number */
    opj_read_bytes(p_header_data, p_tile_no, 2);
    p_header_data += 2;

    /* 4 bytes: Length of tile part */
    opj_read_bytes(p_header_data, p_tot_len, 4);
    p_header_data += 4;

    /* 2 bytes: Index of tile part */
    opj_read_bytes(p_header_data, p_current_part, 2);
    p_header_data += 2;

    /* 2 bytes: Number of tile parts */
    opj_read_bytes(p_header_data, p_num_parts, 2);
    p_header_data += 2;

    return OPJ_TRUE;
}

static OPJ_BOOL opj_j2k_get_sot_values(OPJ_BYTE *  p_header_data,
                                       OPJ_UINT32 p_header_size,
                                       OPJ_UINT32 * p_tile_no,
                                       OPJ_UINT32 * p_tot_len,
                                       OPJ_UINT32 * p_current_part,

                                       opj_event_mgr_t * p_manager)
{
    /* preconditions */
    assert(p_header_data != 00);

    if (p_header_size < 10) {

    /* 2 bytes: Number of tile parts */
